title: Infinitesimal dynamical spectral rigidity of the Bunimovich stadium
summary: We prove the infinitesimal dynamical spectral rigidity of the circular Bunimovich stadium with sufficiently long flat edges, in the class of domains obtained by replacing its two circular arcs with strictly convex $C^{4}$ arcs and keeping its reflection symmetry across the axis parallel to the flat edges. That is, if a $C^{1}$ one-parameter family in this class passing through the stadium preserves the length spectrum, then its deformation function at the stadium vanishes identically.
